SELECT bbb.match_id, bbb.over_id, bbb.ball_id, bbb.innings_no, bbb.striker, bbb.bowler, bbs.runs_scored
FROM ball_by_ball bbb
LEFT JOIN batsman_scored bbs ON bbb.match_id = bbs.match_id AND bbs.over_id = bbs.over_id AND bbs.ball_id = bbs.ball_id AND bbs.innings_no = bbs.innings_no

# Special Words Definition

## Batting Average
- Batting average is a measure of a batsman's performance, calculated by dividing the total number of runs scored by the number of times they have been dismissed. A higher batting average indicates a more consistent and successful batsman.
- Batting Average = Total Runs ÷ Total Dismissals

## Strike Rate
- In batting, strike rate indicates the scoring rate of a batsman, showing the average number of runs scored per 100 balls faced. A higher strike rate reflects an aggressive and fast-scoring batsman.
- Strike Rate = (Total Runs ÷ Balls Faced) × 100

## Wickets Taken
- Wickets taken refers to the total number of times a bowler has successfully dismissed an opposing batsman. This statistic is a core measure of a bowler's effectiveness and impact on the game.

## Economy Rate
- Economy rate measures a bowler's efficiency by indicating the average number of runs conceded per over (6 balls) bowled. A lower economy rate shows greater control and efficiency in restricting the opposition's scoring.
- Economy Rate = (Total Runs Conceded ÷ Balls Bowled) × 6

## Wickets Taken
- The number of times a bowler successfully dismisses a batsman in a single match.  This metric is a direct indicator of the bowler's effectiveness, showing how many players they were able to remove from play.

## Runs Given
- The total number of runs scored by the batting side off a particular bowler’s deliveries in a single match.  This value reflects the runs the bowler has conceded to the batting team, and a lower runs-given value is typically favorable for the bowler's performance.

WITH 
-- Most frequent role per player
most_frequent_role AS (
    SELECT player_id, role, cnt
    FROM (
        SELECT player_id, role, COUNT(*) as cnt
        FROM player_match
        GROUP BY player_id, role
    )
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY player_id ORDER BY cnt DESC, role ASC) = 1
),

-- Total matches played per player
matches_played AS (
    SELECT player_id, COUNT(DISTINCT match_id) as total_matches
    FROM player_match
    GROUP BY player_id
),

-- Total runs scored per player (striker)
runs_scored AS (
    SELECT bbb.striker as player_id, SUM(bbs.runs_scored) as total_runs
    FROM batsman_scored bbs
    JOIN ball_by_ball bbb ON bbs.match_id = bbb.match_id AND bbs.over_id = bbb.over_id AND bbs.ball_id = bbb.ball_id AND bbs.innings_no = bbb.innings_no
    GROUP BY bbb.striker
),

-- Total balls faced per player
balls_faced AS (
    SELECT striker as player_id, COUNT(*) as total_balls
    FROM ball_by_ball
    GROUP BY striker
),

-- Total dismissals per player (as batsman)
dismissals AS (
    SELECT player_out as player_id, COUNT(*) as total_dismissals
    FROM wicket_taken
    GROUP BY player_out
),

-- Per-match runs for highest score and milestone counts
match_runs AS (
    SELECT bbb.striker as player_id, bbb.match_id, SUM(bbs.runs_scored) as match_total
    FROM batsman_scored bbs
    JOIN ball_by_ball bbb ON bbs.match_id = bbb.match_id AND bbs.over_id = bbb.over_id AND bbs.ball_id = bbb.ball_id AND bbs.innings_no = bbb.innings_no
    GROUP BY bbb.striker, bbb.match_id
),

-- Total wickets per bowler
wickets AS (
    SELECT bowler as player_id, COUNT(*) as total_wickets
    FROM ball_by_ball bbb
    JOIN wicket_taken wt ON bbb.match_id = wt.match_id AND bbb.over_id = wt.over_id AND bbb.ball_id = wt.ball_id AND bbb.innings_no = wt.innings_no
    GROUP BY bowler
),

-- Per-match wickets and runs conceded for bowler
bowler_match_stats AS (
    SELECT bbb.bowler as player_id, bbb.match_id, 
           COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE wt.player_out IS NOT NULL) as match_wickets,
           SUM(bbs.runs_scored) as match_runs_conceded
    FROM ball_by_ball bbb
    LEFT JOIN batsman_scored bbs ON bbb.match_id = bbs.match_id AND bbs.over_id = bbs.over_id AND bbs.ball_id = bbs.ball_id AND bbs.innings_no = bbs.innings_no
    LEFT JOIN wicket_taken wt ON bbb.match_id = wt.match_id AND bbb.over_id = wt.over_id AND bbb.ball_id = wt.ball_id AND bbb.innings_no = wt.innings_no
    GROUP BY bbb.bowler, bbb.match_id
),

-- Best bowling performance per player
best_bowling AS (
    SELECT player_id, match_wickets, match_runs_conceded,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY player_id ORDER BY match_wickets DESC, match_runs_conceded ASC) as rn
    FROM bowler_match_stats
    WHERE match_wickets > 0
),

-- Total balls bowled per player
balls_bowled AS (
    SELECT bowler as player_id, COUNT(*) as total_balls_bowled
    FROM ball_by_ball
    WHERE bowler IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY bowler
),

-- Total runs conceded per bowler
runs_conceded AS (
    SELECT bbb.bowler as player_id, SUM(bbs.runs_scored) as total_runs_conceded
    FROM ball_by_ball bbb
    JOIN batsman_scored bbs ON bbb.match_id = bbs.match_id AND bbs.over_id = bbs.over_id AND bbs.ball_id = bbs.ball_id AND bbs.innings_no = bbs.innings_no
    WHERE bbb.bowler IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY bbb.bowler
)

SELECT 
    p.player_id,
    p.player_name,
    mfr.role as most_frequent_role,
    p.batting_hand,
    p.bowling_skill,
    COALESCE(rs.total_runs, 0) as total_runs,
    mp.total_matches,
    COALESCE(d.total_dismissals, 0) as total_dismissals,
    CASE WHEN COALESCE(d.total_dismissals, 0) > 0 THEN ROUND(1.0 * rs.total_runs / d.total_dismissals, 2) ELSE NULL END as batting_average,
    mr.highest_score,
    mr.matches_30,
    mr.matches_50,
    mr.matches_100,
    COALESCE(bf.total_balls, 0) as total_balls_faced,
    CASE WHEN COALESCE(bf.total_balls, 0) > 0 THEN ROUND(1.0 * rs.total_runs / bf.total_balls * 100, 2) ELSE NULL END as strike_rate,
    COALESCE(w.total_wickets, 0) as total_wickets,
    CASE WHEN COALESCE(bb.total_balls_bowled, 0) > 0 THEN ROUND(1.0 * rc.total_runs_conceded / (bb.total_balls_bowled / 6.0), 2) ELSE NULL END as economy_rate,
    CASE WHEN bbest.player_id IS NOT NULL THEN CAST(bbest.match_wickets AS VARCHAR) || '-' || CAST(bbest.match_runs_conceded AS VARCHAR) ELSE NULL END as best_bowling
FROM player p
LEFT JOIN most_frequent_role mfr ON p.player_id = mfr.player_id
LEFT JOIN matches_played mp ON p.player_id = mp.player_id
LEFT JOIN runs_scored rs ON p.player_id = rs.player_id
LEFT JOIN balls_faced bf ON p.player_id = bf.player_id
LEFT JOIN dismissals d ON p.player_id = d.player_id
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT player_id, 
           MAX(match_total) as highest_score,
           SUM(CASE WHEN match_total >= 30 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as matches_30,
           SUM(CASE WHEN match_total >= 50 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as matches_50,
           SUM(CASE WHEN match_total >= 100 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as matches_100
    FROM match_runs
    GROUP BY player_id
) mr ON p.player_id = mr.player_id
LEFT JOIN wickets w ON p.player_id = w.player_id
LEFT JOIN best_bowling bbest ON p.player_id = bbest.player_id AND bbest.rn = 1
LEFT JOIN balls_bowled bb ON p.player_id = bb.player_id
LEFT JOIN runs_conceded rc ON p.player_id = rc.player_id
ORDER BY p.player_id
LIMIT 20"}
